summary.en: Turn an idea into a working website or app.
summary.zh-CN: 把一句想法变成能上线的网站或应用。

question.en: Will AI platforms make standalone app builders redundant?
question.zh-CN: 大模型直接搭应用，独立建站工具还值不值得做？

watchQuestions.en: Does the platform deliver a deployed app, or only code?
watchQuestions.zh-CN: 交付的是已上线应用，还是一段代码？

watchQuestions.en: Does it handle hosting, databases and ongoing changes?
watchQuestions.zh-CN: 托管、数据库和后续修改也一起解决了吗？

summary.en: An AI partner inside a developer’s coding workflow.
summary.zh-CN: 嵌入开发流程，协助写代码、改代码和调试。

question.en: Is coding assistance becoming a standard platform feature?
question.zh-CN: 编程助手会不会变成大模型的标配？

watchQuestions.en: Can it work across a real codebase and verify its changes?
watchQuestions.zh-CN: 能否理解真实代码库并验证修改？

watchQuestions.en: Is the workflow bundled into the developer’s existing subscription?
watchQuestions.zh-CN: 完整工作流程是否包含在开发者已有订阅中？

summary.en: Create illustrations, campaign visuals and original images.
summary.zh-CN: 制作插图、广告视觉和原创图片。

question.en: Why pay for a separate image generator?
question.zh-CN: 如果聊天就能出图，为什么还要单独买生图工具？

watchQuestions.en: Can users reliably control details and revise the same image?
watchQuestions.zh-CN: 用户能否稳定控制细节并连续修改同一张图？

watchQuestions.en: Does the platform support the specialist’s production workflow?
watchQuestions.zh-CN: 平台是否覆盖专业用户的完整制作流程？

summary.en: Create video shots from text and reference images.
summary.zh-CN: 用文字和参考图片生成视频镜头。

question.en: Will video generation become part of every AI subscription?
question.zh-CN: 视频生成会不会变成通用 AI 订阅的自带功能？

watchQuestions.en: Does it preserve characters and scenes across multiple shots?
watchQuestions.zh-CN: 能否保持多镜头中的人物和场景一致？

watchQuestions.en: How much control remains with the creator?
watchQuestions.zh-CN: 创作者能控制多少画面与镜头细节？

summary.en: Turn raw footage into finished videos and short clips.
summary.zh-CN: 把原始素材剪成成片和短视频。

question.en: Can a general AI replace a dedicated video editor?
question.zh-CN: 通用 AI 能否替代独立的视频剪辑产品？

watchQuestions.en: Does the update edit existing footage or just generate new video?
watchQuestions.zh-CN: 更新能剪已有素材，还是只能生成新视频？

watchQuestions.en: Can users control the timeline, captions and final export?
watchQuestions.zh-CN: 时间线、字幕和最终导出能否被精确控制？

summary.en: Produce voiceovers and localize spoken content.
summary.zh-CN: 制作旁白，并把音视频配音成其他语言。

question.en: Will standalone voice tools lose their edge?
question.zh-CN: 独立配音工具的优势会被通用模型吃掉吗？

watchQuestions.en: Can it preserve pronunciation, performance and speaker identity?
watchQuestions.zh-CN: 能否保留准确发音、表达和说话人特征？

watchQuestions.en: Does it deliver synchronized dubbing rather than translated text?
watchQuestions.zh-CN: 交付的是同步配音，还是翻译后的文字？

summary.en: Create sellable product visuals without a full photo shoot.
summary.zh-CN: 不搭完整摄影棚，也能制作商品展示图。

question.en: Will general image tools absorb product photography apps?
question.zh-CN: 通用图像能力会覆盖电商商品图这门生意吗？

watchQuestions.en: Does editing preserve the product’s actual details?
watchQuestions.zh-CN: 编辑是否忠实保留商品真实细节？

watchQuestions.en: Can it process a catalog and deliver marketplace-ready images?
watchQuestions.zh-CN: 能否批量处理商品，并交付符合平台要求的图片？

summary.en: Make songs and soundtracks from a creative brief.
summary.zh-CN: 根据创意制作歌曲与配乐。

question.en: Will music tools remain a separate destination?
question.zh-CN: 音乐工具还会是用户单独购买的产品吗？

watchQuestions.en: Can users steer composition and revise specific sections?
watchQuestions.zh-CN: 用户能否控制创作，并修改指定乐段？

watchQuestions.en: What use rights and export options are explicitly offered?
watchQuestions.zh-CN: 产品明确提供哪些使用权利和导出方式？

summary.en: Go from a brief or document to a presentation.
summary.zh-CN: 把想法或资料变成可以演示的文稿。

question.en: Do users still need a separate AI presentation app?
question.zh-CN: 大模型能做 PPT 后，用户还需要独立演示工具吗？

watchQuestions.en: Does it produce an editable deck or just an outline?
watchQuestions.zh-CN: 能交付可编辑文稿，还是只有大纲？

watchQuestions.en: Can it preserve branding, layout and source data?
watchQuestions.zh-CN: 品牌样式、版式和源数据能否保持准确？

summary.en: Capture meetings and turn conversations into useful notes.
summary.zh-CN: 记录会议，把讨论整理成可用的纪要和后续事项。

question.en: What happens when every meeting platform includes an AI notetaker?
question.zh-CN: 当会议平台自带 AI 纪要，独立工具还剩什么价值？

watchQuestions.en: Does it capture the meeting directly and identify speakers?
watchQuestions.zh-CN: 能否直接记录会议并区分说话人？

watchQuestions.en: Does follow-up reach the tools the team actually uses?
watchQuestions.zh-CN: 会后行动能否进入团队实际使用的系统？

summary.en: Find answers across company documents and work apps.
summary.zh-CN: 跨企业文档和办公应用查找答案。

question.en: Will platform connectors absorb enterprise search?
question.zh-CN: 大模型接入企业应用后，会吃掉企业搜索吗？

watchQuestions.en: Does it respect document permissions and provide traceable answers?
watchQuestions.zh-CN: 是否遵守文档权限，并给出可追溯的答案？

watchQuestions.en: Can it keep knowledge current across the company’s tools?
watchQuestions.zh-CN: 能否持续同步企业多个系统中的知识？

summary.en: Ask business questions and explore company data in plain language.
summary.zh-CN: 用自然语言问业务问题，分析企业数据。

question.en: Will data analysis move into the general AI workspace?
question.zh-CN: 数据分析会被通用 AI 工作区直接包办吗？

watchQuestions.en: Can it use the company’s existing metric definitions?
watchQuestions.zh-CN: 能否沿用企业已有的指标定义？

watchQuestions.en: Does it connect to live data and produce verifiable results?
watchQuestions.zh-CN: 能否连接实际数据并产出可复核结果？

summary.en: Answer customer questions and handle support conversations.
summary.zh-CN: 回答客户问题，承接客服沟通。

question.en: Can a model company replace a customer-support product?
question.zh-CN: 大模型公司能直接替代 AI 客服产品吗？

watchQuestions.en: Does the system resolve requests or only generate replies?
watchQuestions.zh-CN: 系统能实际处理请求，还是只生成回复？

watchQuestions.en: Can it use business systems and hand off to human support?
watchQuestions.zh-CN: 能否操作业务系统，并把问题交接给人工？

summary.en: Find potential customers and support outbound sales.
summary.zh-CN: 寻找潜在客户，协助销售触达。

question.en: Will outbound sales become a built-in agent workflow?
question.zh-CN: 销售获客会变成通用 Agent 自带的流程吗？

watchQuestions.en: Does it have usable prospect data and CRM access?
watchQuestions.zh-CN: 是否具有可用的客户数据和 CRM 接入？

watchQuestions.en: Can users control outreach and measure qualified opportunities?
watchQuestions.zh-CN: 用户能否控制触达，并衡量有效商机？

summary.en: Support legal research, drafting and case work.
summary.zh-CN: 协助法律检索、文书起草和案件工作。

question.en: How much of a legal AI product will general platforms cover?
question.zh-CN: 通用平台会覆盖法律 AI 产品的多少核心价值？

watchQuestions.en: Are legal sources, jurisdiction and citations supported?
watchQuestions.zh-CN: 是否支持适用法域、法律来源和准确引用？

watchQuestions.en: Does it fit a legal team’s case and document workflow?
watchQuestions.zh-CN: 能否进入法律团队的案件与文档工作流程？

summary.en: Turn clinical conversations into documentation.
summary.zh-CN: 将诊疗沟通整理成医疗记录。

question.en: Can general AI take over medical documentation?
question.zh-CN: 通用 AI 能否覆盖医疗文书产品？

watchQuestions.en: Does it support clinical terminology and clinician review?
watchQuestions.zh-CN: 是否支持临床术语和医生审核？

watchQuestions.en: Is the record usable in the clinic’s actual system?
watchQuestions.zh-CN: 生成记录能否用于诊所实际系统？

summary.en: Help teams find, contact and screen candidates.
summary.zh-CN: 帮助团队寻找、联系和筛选候选人。

question.en: Will hiring workflows be absorbed into general agents?
question.zh-CN: 招聘流程会被通用 Agent 覆盖吗？

watchQuestions.en: Does it work with candidate data and the hiring system?
watchQuestions.zh-CN: 是否能接入候选人数据与招聘系统？

watchQuestions.en: Can hiring teams review and control screening decisions?
watchQuestions.zh-CN: 招聘团队能否审核并控制筛选结果？

summary.en: Help businesses keep books and prepare financial records.
summary.zh-CN: 协助企业记账和整理财务记录。

question.en: Can general AI replace an accounting product?
question.zh-CN: 通用 AI 能直接替代财务记账产品吗？

watchQuestions.en: Does it reconcile real records rather than generate explanations?
watchQuestions.zh-CN: 能核对实际账目，还是只生成解释？

watchQuestions.en: Are review, audit history and accounting-system integration included?
watchQuestions.zh-CN: 是否包含审核、审计记录和财务系统接入？

summary.en: Practice a language with an always-available conversation partner.
summary.zh-CN: 随时进行语言对话练习。

question.en: Why keep a language app when general AI can talk?
question.zh-CN: 通用 AI 能对话后，为什么还需要语言陪练应用？

watchQuestions.en: Does it provide a learning path and track progress?
watchQuestions.zh-CN: 是否有学习路径并跟踪进展？

watchQuestions.en: Can it give useful feedback on speech and recurring mistakes?
watchQuestions.zh-CN: 能否针对发音和反复出现的问题给出反馈？

summary.en: Build ongoing conversations with AI characters and companions.
summary.zh-CN: 与 AI 角色和伙伴保持持续对话。

question.en: Will general assistants compete for the same relationships?
question.zh-CN: 通用助手会争夺 AI 陪伴产品的用户吗？

watchQuestions.en: Does it support continuity, memory and character identity?
watchQuestions.zh-CN: 能否保持对话、记忆和角色的一致性？

watchQuestions.en: What makes the experience distinct from a general assistant?
watchQuestions.zh-CN: 体验中哪些部分让它区别于通用助手？
